posts.author: DigiFlash
posts.content_md:
I'm not frequent on this forum, so sorry for my late, and probably not specific answer. 

My company is currently working with several artists completing their MFAs in different universities and as part of their program they will produce 

digital full color hologram. But their work relates more to the field of 3d perception, illusion, digital arts etc.. rather than lasers, holography etc..

The advantage of this approach - it can be done anywhere without the need to have the holographic lab on site. Digital files are getting transferred and printed holograms are sent back.
